subject: turtle
name: 小乌龟
label: 圆壳小乌龟
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One small land turtle side view, dome shell with only two dividing arcs, four stubby legs and friendly head.
Keep this a clean black contour drawing: smooth blank interiors, no dense repetitive texture, no shading or gray tonal fills. Keep the complete silhouette within the canvas with clear surrounding margins.
